strategyFamily: market-neutral spot/perpetual funding and basis carry
motivation: Evaluate a genuinely different, low-turnover return source after the directional ridge robustness failure. This is not a rescue or parameter modification of trial 1.

requiredSeries: spot price at entry, every funding timestamp, and exit
USD-M perpetual mark or executable price at entry, every funding timestamp, and exit
realized 8-hour funding rate at every payment timestamp
dataRequirements.preferredPrimarySource: Binance public data archive / official funding-rate endpoint
dataRequirements.secondaryIntegrityCheck: Torch-Trade BTCUSDT 8h funding dataset sourced from Binance Data Collection
rejectEvaluationIf: spot and perpetual timestamps cannot be synchronized without forward-looking interpolation
funding observations are missing around an open position
perpetual mark/executable prices are unavailable for basis P&L and margin stress
the exact downloaded inputs cannot be hashed

candidate.position: long BTC spot and short equal BTC units of BTCUSDT perpetual
candidate.entryRule: enter once at the beginning of an evaluation window; no forecast threshold and no funding-sign timing
candidate.exitRule: exit both legs at the end of the evaluation window
candidate.rebalancing: none; keep equal BTC units on both legs so first-order BTC delta remains offset
candidate.fundingAccounting: for each realized funding timestamp, short receives positive funding and pays negative funding on contemporaneous perpetual notional
candidate.basisAccounting: mark both legs independently; net price P&L must include spot/perpetual entry and exit basis rather than assuming convergence or perfect cancellation

costModel.note: The same conservative MoneyMog friction is applied to both legs for the first research pass rather than assuming institutional futures fees or perfect maker fills.

marginStress.liquidationRule: fail the strategy at the first timestamp where futures collateral plus accumulated futures P&L and funding falls below maintenance margin

evaluation.historicalHoldoutIntegrity: Any historical result using the Torch-Trade series is development/robustness evidence, not pristine validation, because whole-sample summary statistics were viewed before this manifest was frozen.
evaluation.promotionRequires: a later untouched forward or independently sealed evaluation in addition to positive net-of-cost historical robustness

antiRescueRule: No funding threshold, sign filter, leverage change, entry date selection, or rebalancing rule may be introduced after seeing this candidate's first result under trial 2. Any such change is a new numbered trial.
